title: clampOffsets is slow — 8-12s p99 on clusters with >10k consumer groups
description:
During a failover operation, ClusterLinking.clampOffsets() must find every consumer group subscribed to the topics being failed over, then translate and clamp their offsets to valid destination positions.

Observed: cluster with 50,000 consumer groups takes 8-12 seconds to complete clampOffsets.
During active failover this causes consumer lag spikes.
listGroups + describeGroups fan-out generates a thundering herd on GroupCoordinator.

Hypothesis: we need an indexed lookup — listGroupsForTopicPartition(topic, partition) — instead of the current O(n_groups) scan.

Needs review from Consumer Team (owns GroupCoordinator) and OSS Kafka (protocol change may need a KIP).
